reuse.why: The exclusion is added to the existing shared shouldWriteMonthActionCategory predicate, but the #fixed detection itself is pasted into each action's own query instead of a shared selection.

duplication.why: The same CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(n.note,'')) LIKE '%#fixed%' expression and notes join are copied into six SQL queries.

placement.why: Everything stays in budget/actions.ts with the decision in the shared predicate, but the tag-matching rule lives in SQL strings at every call site.

scope.why: Only the month-wide action queries, the predicate and its types change.

maintainability.why: Changing how the tag is recognised means editing six identical SQL fragments that can easily drift.

one_place.where: The exclusion decision is in shouldWriteMonthActionCategory, but what counts as a #fixed group is defined separately in six queries in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts (getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg)
